pass_mark: As the protocol's section 3, "Pass marks", unchanged; each tier names what the source gives after day 4,087: Every mark is in units of the stated beginning-of-mission power: 115.4 W for Curiosity, 116.6 W for Perseverance. The difference is forecast minus measured. One verdict is given per unit per source, from the highest tier the source supports. Values of a lower tier that do not overlap it are reported beside it. Tier A: Daily values, 365 or more. Marks: The served card's tier-1 lines: rms of the daily differences at most 0.010, and mean of the differences over the final 365 days (the 365 latest days with values) at most 0.010 in size. Verdict words: met / missed. Tier B: Daily values, 30 to 364. Marks: rms at most 0.010, and mean over all scored days at most 0.010 in size. Verdict words: met in part / missed in part. Tier C: Three or more means over stated periods of 7 days or more, with midpoints spanning 180 days or more. Marks: Each mean is compared with the forecast's mean over the same days. rms at most 0.010, and mean at most 0.010 in size. Verdict words: met in part / missed in part. Tier D: Anything less: fewer daily values, fewer or shorter periods, or a single value on a stated date. Marks: Every difference at most 0.010 in size. A value dated only to a month or a year is compared with the forecast's mean over that month or year. Verdict words: met at N points / missed at N points. A point tests the level, not the shape. Also reported: the whole mean, the worst day, and whether the half lines (0.005) are met. Too little to score. These are reported and not scored: no value of the F1 generator's electrical output dated after 2023-10-15; values shown only in a figure; no value is read off a plot; projections, predictions, design values and model outputs; values the source qualifies as approximate ("about", "~"), or printed coarser than 1 W; values with no date, or dated only to a span longer than a calendar year, unless given as a mean over a stated period; spacecraft-bus, battery, heat, voltage or current quantities in place of the generator's electrical output. Tier 2, Perseverance (F2). The primary is applied unchanged at Perseverance's days since its landing on 2021-02-18, on values after its day 985, with the same tiers and 116.6 W. Its result is reported and is not part of the F1 verdict.
